plan.title: Implement planOrder with order, stages and typed errors
plan.description: Implement planOrder(tasks: TaskSpec[]) => {order, stages} using Kahn topological sort. Detect duplicate ids, unknown dependencies, and cycles and throw typed errors extending TaskPlanError per SPEC.md section 2. Export from src/index.ts and add JSDoc API comments. Read SPEC.md for exact error types/messages and expected order/stages semantics.
acceptance: planOrder returns topological order containing all task ids and stages grouped for parallel execution
duplicate id throws DuplicateTaskError (or equivalent) with typed error
unknown dependency throws UnknownDependencyError with typed error
cycle throws CycleError with typed error containing cycle path
tsc passes and planner check group tests pass
plan.reason: Complex graph algorithm with cycle detection and typed error design requires strong reasoning
plan.escalate_if: SPEC error types/messages ambiguous or cycle reporting requires non-trivial design

plan.title: Add plan CLI command with formats, errors and exit codes
plan.description: Create src/cli.ts implementing `plan` command per SPEC.md section 3: read tasks JSON file, call planOrder, support output formats (e.g. --format json/text/graph), handle file-not-found/parse/planning errors with typed messages and correct exit codes (0 success, 1 planning error, 2 usage). Wire export via src/index.ts if needed. Depends on planner for planOrder API.
acceptance: `node src/cli.ts plan <file>` outputs order and stages in requested format
invalid file/args prints to stderr and exits 2
planning errors (duplicate/unknown/cycle) print typed message and exit 1
plan.reason: CLI arg parsing, format handling and exit-code mapping needs solid reasoning; cheap model risks missing edge cases
plan.escalate_if: Output format spec requires complex templating

plan.title: Add runnable example, README Planning section and CHANGELOG entry
plan.description: Create examples/basic.ts runnable example that imports planOrder and logs order/stages per SPEC.md 4. Add README.md Planning section documenting planOrder API, stages concept and CLI usage. Add CHANGELOG.md entry for new feature. Ensure JSDoc comments exist on exported planner API. Depends on planner and cli for correct API/usage details.
acceptance: examples/basic.ts runs with `npx tsx examples/basic.ts` and prints expected order/stages
README contains Planning section with planOrder and plan CLI documentation
CHANGELOG has new version entry describing planOrder, CLI and error types
plan.reason: Docs and example are mechanical writing tasks with low risk
plan.escalate_if: Example output mismatches planner output requiring logic fix

findings.evidence: Baseline InvalidTaskError sets this.name explicitly; new error classes do not set this.name, which may lead to inconsistent error.name reporting though not required by the contract.
findings.suggested_check: Inspect TaskPlanError/InvalidTaskError in src/errors.ts to see if it sets name, then verify new errors expose meaningful name for debugging.

findings.evidence: Remaining-set collection uses order.includes inside a loop giving O(n^2) and contains redundant fallback branches; simpler collection of nodes not in order would be clearer.
findings.suggested_check: Run planner on a cycle of 3+ nodes and verify remaining set contains exactly the cyclic component.
